headline: AWS accelerates to fastest pace in 18 quarters
chart_note: 52-week range: $196.00 - $287.20. Currently $252.40, up from the 52-week low but still below its high.
why_today: Q2 2026 net sales hit $200.6B, up 20% YoY. AWS revenue jumped 37% YoY to $42.2B - its fastest growth pace in 18 quarters, helped by an AI-related boost from Anthropic. Operating income rose 43% YoY to $27.5B, outpacing revenue growth.
pro_1: AWS reaccelerating just as AI-cloud demand peaks - fastest growth in over 4 years
pro_2: 61 analysts rate it Strong Buy, average price target of $328 implies roughly 30% upside
con_1: PE of 35x is a premium versus the broader market, leaving less room for error
con_2: Retail margins remain thinner than AWS, so any cloud slowdown would hit profitability hard
